author: Apple
description:
When Amanda’s Apple Watch flagged changes in her resting heart rate and overnight vitals, she saw her GP. Doctors uncovered a rare, aggressive cancer and began life-saving treatment just in time.

Learn more about Apple Watch heart rate notifications at https://apple.co/4cnleD2

title: Apple Watch Heart Rate: Amanda’s True Apple Watch Story
